DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Copilot review thread PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fDmom on PR #408 — CleanupCheckpoints classifies eligibility with readCheckpointFileNoFollow then archives via os.Rename on the original path. A concurrent writer replacing the file between read and rename could cause archiving of the wrong file. This is a pre-existing TOCTOU in CleanupCheckpoints (not introduced by U1 symlink hardening). Fix requires content re-verification at rename boundary (similar to moveNoReplace's bytes.Equal check) or handle-relative rename. Reason out of scope: P-021 C1 — U1's contract is symlink rejection in read verbs; addressing file-replacement TOCTOU in cleanup exceeds that scope.
